architecture_summary: Evaluated 11 microservices and 24 inter-service call paths. Frontend proxies traffic into core domain services: cart, catalog, and checkout. Primary systemic risk identified in single-point-of-failure cascade between frontend and stateful services.

experiments.name: Cart Service Total Outage Simulation
experiments.hypothesis: Pausing cart will trigger 500 errors in user add-to-cart operations unless fallback in-memory or degraded cart mode exists.
experiments.rationale: Cart is directly downstream of frontend proxy; high caller volume makes it critical for shopping workflow.

experiments.name: Valkey-Cart Stateful Datastore SPOF Outage
experiments.hypothesis: Freezing valkey-cart will break the Redis session store and cause cart read/write gRPC RPCs to timeout.
experiments.rationale: Valkey-cart is the single persistent datastore for cart sessions. Tests whether cart service degrades to local memory or fails hard.

experiments.name: Recommendation Engine Kernel Netem 500ms Delay
experiments.hypothesis: Applying real kernel-level tc netem 500ms latency will increase overall page response time unless frontend calls it asynchronously with hedged timeouts.
experiments.rationale: Infrastructure-level network degradation applied via netshoot sidecar to verify graceful degradation on peripheral microservices.
